column1: # Commands that put a Proton Pass value in front of the agent.
# TODO(LAR-526): decide whether access-changing commands (item/vault share,
# agent access grant, ssh-agent, password generate) belong here too.
# This header is the format contract. hooks/guard.jq, test/guard.test.mjs and
# the permissions.deny (S12) and OpenCode (S16) snippet generators all read the
# file this way, so edit the list here only.
# - A line that is empty, only whitespace, or starts with # (after optional
#   whitespace) is skipped. Every other line is <pattern><TAB><reason>, with
#   the pattern's words separated by single spaces. If any row breaks this, or
#   there are no rows, the guard blocks every command that names openv or
#   pass-cli rather than guess.
# - Before matching, quotes are removed and backslash-newlines joined, as the
#   shell would, so "/opt/homebrew/bin/pass-cli" item view and a command split
#   over two lines both match.
# - A word pattern matches when its words appear in order as whole tokens,
#   separated by whitespace or a ")" (for $(which pass-cli) item view). The
#   first word may carry a path (/opt/homebrew/bin/pass-cli) and must start a
#   token: at the start of the line, or after any character other than a
#   letter, digit, _ . / or -.
# - A --flag pattern matches as a whole token anywhere in a command that also
#   names openv, pass-cli or pass://.
openv export
column2: prints resolved values for your shell; run it in your own terminal, not here
